panel.title: Everything about your orders in one place
panel.text: Create an account to manage purchases, invoices and delivery addresses faster — as a private customer or as a business.
panel.note: B2B prices and payment by invoice become available once we have verified and approved your company details.

b2b.title: B2B prices for businesses
b2b.text: A personal discount and prices excl. VAT across the whole catalogue.

history.title: Order history
history.text: Status, delivery and every detail of each purchase.

invoices.title: PDF invoices
invoices.text: Download proforma and final invoices at any time.

reorder.title: Fast reorder
reorder.text: Put a previous order back in your cart with one click.

notConfigured.title: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable
notConfigured.text: Customer accounts are still being set up. You can still place an order without registering or get in touch with us.

strength.label: Strength
strength.hint: At least 8 characters; upper and lower case letters, digits and symbols make it stronger.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: View your orders, download invoices and shop with your own prices.
login.magicHint: We'll email you a one-time sign-in link — no password needed. If you don't have an account yet, one will be created automatically.
login.magicSentText: We've sent a sign-in link to

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Registration takes less than a minute.
register.businessNote: After you register we'll verify your company details and assign B2B prices. Until then you can shop at regular prices.
register.terms: I agree to the <link>terms of use</link> and have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>
register.marketing: I'd like to receive news and offers by email (no more than once a month)
register.checkEmailText: We've sent a confirmation link to
register.checkEmailHint: Open the email and click the link to activate your account. If you can't find it, check your spam folder.
register.checkEmailBusiness: Once your email is confirmed, your business application goes to our team. We'll let you know by email when your B2B status is approved.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentText: If an account with this address exists, a password reset link has been sent to

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use for other services.
reset.noSession: The password reset link is invalid or has expired.

errors.callback: The link is invalid or has expired. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Your email hasn't been confirmed yet. Please check your inbox.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in or resetting your password.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too simple. Choose a longer or more complex one.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.userNotFound: No account was found with this email.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.tooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
errors.terms: Please accept the terms of use to continue.
errors.companyRequired: Please enter the company name and registration number.

common.loadError: Some data couldn't be loaded. Please refresh the page or try again later.

errors.invalid: Please check the details you entered.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.locked: Details of an approved business can only be changed by contacting us.

overview.noOrdersText: Once you place your first order it will show up here together with its status and invoices.

b2b.noneText: Businesses get a personal discount, prices excl. VAT and payment by invoice.
b2b.pendingTitle: Your B2B application is in review
b2b.pendingText: We're verifying your company details. As soon as your status is approved, prices in your account will update automatically.
b2b.approvedText: The catalogue shows your prices excl. VAT with your discount applied.
b2b.rejectedText: Unfortunately we couldn't approve B2B status at this time. Get in touch and we'll help find a solution.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: All your orders with their status and totals.
orders.emptyText: Pick products in the catalogue — your orders will appear here.

order.title: Order {number}

order.noInvoices: No invoice has been issued for this order yet.
order.notFoundText: The link may be wrong or the order belongs to a different account.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Proforma invoices, invoices and credit notes — downloadable as PDF.
invoices.emptyText: Invoices will appear here as soon as they are issued for your orders.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Contact details, language and sign-in settings.
profile.personalText: These details are used when you place orders.
profile.languageHint: We'll send emails and invoices in this language.
profile.marketHint: Determines the applicable VAT rate and delivery options.
profile.marketingHint: Seasonal offers and news — no more than once a month. You can unsubscribe at any time.
profile.emailText: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address.
profile.emailSentText: To complete the change, open the link we sent to your new email address.
profile.emailSame: Enter a new email address that differs from the current one.
profile.passwordText: We recommend a unique password that you don't use elsewhere.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.subtitle: Saved delivery addresses for faster checkout.
addresses.emptyText: Add a delivery address and it will be filled in automatically next time you order.

business.title: Business & B2B
business.subtitle: Company details and B2B terms.

none.title: Become a B2B customer
none.text: Fill in your company details — once verified we'll assign personal prices and the option to pay by invoice.

pending.title: Your application is in review
pending.text: We've received your company details and are verifying them. We'll email you with the decision.

approved.title: B2B status approved
approved.text: The catalogue and cart show your prices excl. VAT with your discount applied.

rejected.title: Application not approved
rejected.text: We couldn't approve B2B status at this time. Contact us, or update your company details and apply again.

business.termsHint: You can pay for orders by invoice within this period.
business.lockedNote: To change the details of an approved business, please contact us.
business.vatHint: Required to apply reverse-charge VAT to deliveries to Estonia or Lithuania.
business.formText: Enter your company details exactly as registered in the business register.
business.formTextPending: You can update the details while your application is being reviewed.
business.consentNote: By submitting you confirm that you are authorised to represent this company.
business.submittedText: We'll verify the details and let you know by email.

prices.title: Personal pricing
prices.text: A personal discount and prices excl. VAT across the catalogue.

invoice.title: Pay by invoice
invoice.text: Deferred payment with agreed payment terms.

documents.title: Documents in one place
documents.text: All invoices and your order history in your account.

manager.title: Personal contact
manager.text: Help with choosing products and with larger volume deliveries.
